_comment: Page copy for index.html. Edited through the CMS at /admin. tools/build-pages.js writes these values back into the HTML at deploy time, so the text stays crawlable.
hero__p-1: We exist to honor the life and legacy of Tykeem D'Majh Franklin by empowering youth through education, athletics, and community support.
mission__p-1: Ty's Future Stars Foundation empowers youth through basketball, education, mentorship, and scholarship opportunities in honor of Tykeem D'Majh Franklin. Through community support and athletic development, we help student-athletes reach their full potential both on and off the court.
four-pillars__p-1: We support academic achievement by providing scholarships and resources.
four-pillars__p-2: We build confidence, leadership, and life skills through sports and mentorship.
four-pillars__p-3: We inspire youth to dream big and create better futures for themselves.
four-pillars__p-4: We transform pain into purpose and communities through love and legacy.
ty-s-story-teaser__h2-1: Out of unimaginable loss came extraordinary purpose.
ty-s-story-teaser__p-1: Ty was a son, a brother, an uncle, a loyal friend, and a gifted athlete whose life reflected determination, compassion, and purpose. His journey was cut short on July 16, 2020 — two days before his 24th birthday.
ty-s-story-teaser__p-2: His passing left an immeasurable void, but it ignited a mission that ensures his name and purpose will never be forgotten.
scholarship-impact__p-1: awarded in scholarships since our inception — supporting young athletes as they pursue their aspirations on and off the court.
founder__p-1: Ty's Future Stars Foundation was founded to carry Ty's light forward — and to make sure other families never have to endure the same loss.
founder__blockquote-1: "She believes faith, love, and purpose can transform pain into legacy and is committed to helping others live with compassion, strength, and hope."
motto-cta__p-1: Every scholarship awarded, every young person mentored, and every community event hosted reflects the values Ty embodied: hope, perseverance, kindness, leadership, and service.
motto-cta__p-2: Together, we can be the change.
